data.one_liner: CLI tool to rapidly switch between channels and versions of standalone Dart.
data.what_it_does: DSwitch lets developers rapidly switch between Dart channels (stable, beta, dev) and specific SDK versions. It also allows pinning a channel to a specific version for standalone environments like CLI development.
use_when: You need to manage and switch between multiple standalone Dart SDK versions
You are developing Dart CLI applications outside of Flutter
avoid_when: You are building Flutter applications (use FVM instead)
strengths: Allows rapid switching between Dart channels and versions
Supports pinning a channel to a specific version
Includes verification and staging processes for downloads
weaknesses: Not suitable for Flutter projects since it does not manage the Dart version embedded in Flutter
